name: cheap-trick
description: Always-on supervisor for multi-step work on Grok Build: grok-4.6 plans the split between what it must keep and what grok-4.5 can do, dispatches the grind with spawn_subagent, and stops to warn when delegating would lose session context. Installs the skill, plus a one-time /cheap-trick-setup command that writes the always-on rules file.
